# BLOODHOUND — QA Plan V2
**For: QA Agent | Generated by: PLAN Agent | Date: 2026-02-28**
**Branch: master | Base commit: 5137b20**

> Read this file in full before running any tests. Each sprint maps to a specific feature area.
> All items marked ✅ DONE were fixed in the prior session — verify they still work, then test the open items.

---

## Testing Philosophy

- **Every user story has a FAIL condition** — if the FAIL condition is true, file a bug.
- **Test in order** — earlier sprints are prerequisites for later ones.
- **Test with real data** — once backend is deployed, no test is valid against mocked/hardcoded data.
- **Device targets:** Chrome desktop (1440px), Chrome mobile emulation (390px iPhone 14), Firefox desktop.
- **Auth states:** always test both signed-out and signed-in flows separately.

---

## Pre-Test Checklist (Run Before Every QA Sprint)

- [ ] Backend is deployed and `/health` returns `{"status":"ok"}`
- [ ] Vercel frontend is deployed with correct `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`
- [ ] You have a test Clerk account (free tier) for auth-gated tests
- [ ] You have at least 3 real Solana wallet addresses saved for testing (use public KOL wallets)
- [ ] ClickHouse has data (at least 100 transfers ingested via webhook)

## Sprint Q2 — Search & Explorer
**Core flow: universal search routes correctly.**

**US-Q201 — Wallet Address Search**
> As a trader, I can paste any Solana wallet address and land on the wallet profile.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | A valid 44-char base58 wallet address |
| **When** | User pastes it into search bar and presses Enter |
| **Then** | Navigates to `/wallet/{address}` within 500ms |
| **FAIL** | Stays on explorer page OR navigates to wrong route OR shows error |

**Edge cases:**
- 43-char address → shows "Invalid address" error inline, does not navigate
- Transaction signature (88 chars) → routes to `/tx/{sig}`
- Token mint address → routes to `/token/{mint}`
- Partial address (10 chars) → shows "Invalid" error, does not navigate

**US-Q202 — Autocomplete Suggestions**
> As a user typing in search, I see relevant known wallet suggestions.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | `known_wallets` table has seeded data with labels |
| **When** | User types 3+ characters matching a known label |
| **Then** | Dropdown appears within 100ms with matching suggestions |
| **FAIL** | No suggestions appear OR delay > 500ms OR suggestions appear for every single keypress with no debounce |

**US-Q203 — Recent Search History**
> As a user, I see my last 6 searches in the explorer.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Given** | User has searched for addresses before |
| **When** | User visits `/explorer` |
| **Then** | Shows up to 6 recent searches from localStorage (`bh_recent_searches` key) |
| **FAIL** | Shows empty "Recently viewed" OR shows stale/incorrect entries OR shows more than 6 |

## Sprint Q16 — Edge Cases & Security

| Test | Expected |
|---|---|
| XSS in search input: `<script>alert(1)</script>` | Sanitized, not executed |
| SQL injection in search: `'; DROP TABLE--` | Treated as literal string, no DB error |
| Very long address (500 chars) | Shows validation error, no crash |
| Concurrent tab usage (same user) | Both tabs work independently |
| Sign out mid-session | Auth-gated pages redirect to sign-in immediately |
| Expired Ably token | Connection auto-reconnects via `authUrl`, no user-visible error |
| ClickHouse returns empty result | Empty state rendered, not null pointer crash |
| Birdeye returns 429 | Wallet/token page shows "price data temporarily unavailable" |
| Helius returns 503 | Tx page shows "Network temporarily unavailable" |

## Bug Report Template

When a test fails, file a bug with this structure:

```
**Bug ID:** Q{sprint}-{number}
**Sprint:** Q{N}
**Test Case:** US-Q{NNN}
**Severity:** Critical / High / Medium / Low
**Page/Endpoint:**
**Steps to Reproduce:**
  1.
  2.
**Expected:**
**Actual:**
**Environment:** Chrome 121 / Desktop 1440px / Signed in
**Console errors:** (paste any)
**Network errors:** (paste any failing requests)
```

---

## Severity Definitions

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Critical** | Crash, data loss, security vulnerability, core flow broken |
| **High** | Feature doesn't work at all, wrong data shown, auth bypass |
| **Medium** | Feature works but with bad UX (slow, ugly, confusing) |
| **Low** | Cosmetic, typos, minor inconsistencies |
